panels.title: Fetch rate
panels.description: Bytes per second the FUSE clients fetch from data nodes (cache hits excluded), summed over the selection. Should follow the number of active streams.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_fuse_get_chunk_bytes" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.role, set: ${role:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "throughput"}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: Cache misses
panels.description: Chunk reads over the selected range that no client cache served and had to go to a data node. A high count with slow reads means readahead is not keeping up.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_fuse_chunk_cache_misses" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.role, set: ${role:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> spread()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "misses"}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sum()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "_field"])

panels.title: FUSE op errors
panels.description: Failed FUSE operations over the selected range. Anything above 0 means a player may have seen an I/O error; see the errno panel. ENOENT and EEXIST are left out: a lookup of a missing name or a create of an existing one is a normal answer, not a failure (the errno panels show them).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_fuse_op_errors" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.role, set: ${role:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.errno != "ENOENT" and r.errno != "EEXIST")
  |> spread()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "errors"}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sum()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "_field"])

panels.title: Get failures

panels.title: FUSE read p99
panels.description: 99th percentile latency of FUSE read calls, maximum across the selected nodes. Sustained values above a few seconds starve a Plex stream.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_fuse_op_us" and r._field == "p99")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.role, set: ${role:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.op =~ /^read$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "read p99"}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: FUSE metadata op p99 by op
panels.description: 99th percentile of lookup, getattr, open and readdir calls. Slow metadata delays playback start and library scans; normally well under a second.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_fuse_op_us" and r._field == "p99")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.role, set: ${role:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.op =~ /^(lookup|getattr|open|readdir|readdirplus)$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "p99" + " " + r.node + " " + (if exists r.op then r.op else "-")}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: FUSE op errors by op and errno

  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "chosen" + " " + r.node + " " + (if exists r.tier then r.tier else "-") + " " + (if exists r.src_dc then r.src_dc else "-")}))
